sentences.text: Vishram vs The State Of U.P. on 15 November, 2019

Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh
Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 13
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 696 of 2007
Revisionist :- Vishram

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Ashok Kumar Maurya,A. Maurya,Amanur Rahman,Digvijai Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
This revision has remained pending after admission on 8.4.2008.
Order sheet would reveal that the learned counsel for the revisionist has been seeking adjournments on each and every date when the matter has been listed.
This Court, therefore, vide order dated 8.11.2019 directed the case to be listed today peremptorily.
Despite the case being taken up in the revised call, no one has put in appearance on behalf of the revisionist to prosecute the case.

The present revision has been filed against the judgement and order dated 15.12.2007 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.C., Court No.9, Lucknow in Criminal Appeal No.72 of 2006,
whereby the appeal filed against the judgement and order dated 3.8.2006 passed by the learned Magistrate court in Criminal Case No.840 of 1993, under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act has been dismissed.
Vishram vs The State Of U.P. on 15 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30996378/

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.C., Court No.9, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Vishram vs The State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Magistrate vide order dated 3.8.2006 convicted the accused and sentenced him under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for one year rigorous imprisonment with a fine of Rs.2,000/-

The appellate court after re-appreciating the entire evidence, has come to the same conclusion as was drawn by the learned Magistrate in respect of the commission of offence of culpability of the accused.
I have gone through the two judgments and orders passed by the courts below and perused the evidence on record.
I do not find any infirmity or illegality in the impugned judgement and orders passed by the courts below.
Revision being without any merit and substance, is dismissed.
Let a copy of this order and the lower court record be sent back to the court below forthwith.

Order Date :- 15.11.2019 Rao/-
